notes: Read all 1586 numbered source lines before editing. Ported verbatim as portable core data/logic: navI18nKeys (L73-81, kept empty so labels render as authored); navSearchKeywords (L83-180, every keyword-map entry); DEFAULT_PINNED_NAV_PATHS / MAX_PINNED_NAV_ITEMS / MAX_RECENT_NAV_ITEMS and the three localStorage key constants (L182-187); SECTION_ICON_STYLES (L189-210 — every accent/surface/ring/dot/gradient token kept verbatim for visual-intent parity, the lucide `icon: typeof Icons.home` component reference becomes the matching SemanticIconName); SHOW_RECENTLY_USED_NAV=false (L226); navSections (L240-440 — the full Home..About tree, every {to, icon, label, color} plus minVehicles/requiresAuth/dataTour flags; the two HelixMark items keep brandMark:'helix' and render the native HelixMark).

Pure routing helpers ported behaviour-identical: isVisibleNavItem (L445-452, minVehicles + requiresAuth gates), isActiveNavPath (L454-458, root-exact vs prefix), findNavItemByPath (L460-466), findNavItemByExactPath (L468-474). The renderNavLink badges for /notifications/alerts, /vehicles, /data-repair (L1024-1038) are reproduced in NavLinkRow + badgeForItem.

The realtime-alert onAlert handler (L667-704) is preserved as deriveAlertToast(): the severity->toast-type map (critical->error, warning->warning, else info), the 'build a drill-through action only when created_at|rule_signal|vehicle_id is known' branch, and the title/message fallbacks ('alerts.toast.title'->'Alert', 'alerts.toast.view'->'View'). getAlertDrillthroughHref (not yet ported) is injected as resolveHref, defaulting to the documented /signal-explorer fallback. The three sidebar useQuery descriptors (L810, L811, L833) are preserved verbatim in SIDEBAR_QUERIES with their exact query keys, API paths ('/alerts?limit=50&offset=0', '/vehicles', '/data-repair/stale-sessions'), 30s/60s refetch intervals, and retry:1.

Render: the JSX shell (L1046-1585 — SkipToContent, AnnouncerRegion, ambient glows, mobile overlay/drawer, <aside> sidebar with logo/ThemeQuickSwitcher/CommandPaletteTrigger/VehiclePicker, the legacy <nav> active-section card + Pinned + Sections blocks, mobile header, <main> with breadcrumbs + RouteTransition + <Outlet>, BottomTabBar, StatusBar, CommandPalette, and the 20+ banners/modals/overlays) is reproduced with React Native primitives: a ScrollView sidebar (brand row + ThemeQuickSwitcher, command-palette trigger, vehicle-scope picker, active-section pin card, Pinned group, expand/collapse Sections list with SemanticIcon glyphs and count badges) and a ScrollView content host that renders `children` (the native <Outlet>), a breadcrumb row, a documented LAYOUT_GLOBAL_SURFACES panel (all 27 mounted surfaces) and a BROWSER_ONLY_ADAPTATIONS panel. The ThemeQuickSwitcher (L499-627) is ported as an inline native popover preserving open state + placement + the /settings#appearance Customize action.

Browser-only adaptations (each native-safe, also enumerated in BROWSER_ONLY_ADAPTATIONS): (1) react-router-dom Outlet/useLocation/useNavigate -> children + currentPath + onNavigate props (native navigator owns history). (2) @tanstack/react-query useQuery sidebar fetches -> alerts/vehicles/staleSessions props, with SIDEBAR_QUERIES keeping the exact keys/paths/cadences. (3) window.localStorage + the cross-tab `storage` event -> an in-process navPreferenceStore Map mirroring getItem/setItem + try/catch (AsyncStorage in a real host); resetNavPreferenceStore() is the cold-start analog. (4) framer-motion motion/AnimatePresence layout/height springs -> static native sections. (5) createPortal + getBoundingClientRect popover coords + window CustomEvents (open-theme-popover, open-feedback-modal, toggle-keyboard-shortcuts, TOUR_START_EVENT, broadcast) -> inline popover + documented host wiring. (6) document.querySelector + scrollIntoView active-link auto-scroll (L885-910) and matchMedia prefers-reduced-motion -> dropped (no DOM). (7) the tour engine (useTour/TOURS, L741-804, L815-830), keyboard-shortcut hooks (L716, L725-729), feedback modal event (L734-739), and tab-badge hooks useTitleBadge/useFaviconBadge/useDynamicAppIcon/useCriticalAlertFlash (L705-715) have no native analog and are documented rather than imported. (8) lucide Icons.* -> SemanticIcon glyphs; Helix brand mark keeps native HelixMark. (9) react-i18next useTranslation -> a native t(key, default, params) fallback that interpolates {{name}} placeholders, preserving every key + default string.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, react-router-dom, framer-motion, react-dom/createPortal, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components/ui imports in the native output — only react, react-native, the native theme tokens, AppText/GlassPanel/StatusPill, SemanticIcon, the native HelixMark port, and api/types.
